variables.name: technology
variables.input:
smartscapeNodes PROCESS
| fieldsAdd tech_types = arrayConcat(coalesce(process.software_technologies.os, array()), coalesce(process.software_technologies.java, array()))[][type]
| expand tech_types
| filter in(tech_types, array("JAVA","DOTNET","NODE_JS","PYTHON","PHP","GO","NGINX","APACHE_HTTP_SERVER","IIS_APP_POOL","APACHE_TOMCAT","SPRING","APACHE_LOG4J","APACHE_KAFKA","REDIS","IBM_WEBSPHERE_APPLICATION_SERVER","IBM_WEBSPHERE_LIBERTY","OPEN_LIBERTY","ORACLE_WEBLOGIC","WILDFLY","JBOSS_EAP"))
| fields technology = tech_types
| dedup technology
| sort technology asc

variables.name: host.name
variables.input:
data record(host.name = "*ALL*")
| append [ smartscapeNodes HOST | fields host.name = name | dedup host.name ]
| dedup host.name
| sort host.name asc

variables.name: tech_version
variables.input:
data record(tech_version = "*ALL*")
| append [
    smartscapeNodes PROCESS
    | fieldsAdd technology = arrayConcat(coalesce(process.software_technologies.os, array()), coalesce(process.software_technologies.java, array()))
    | expand technology
    | filter in(technology[type], if(arraySize(array($technology)) == 0, array(""), else: array($technology)))
    | fieldsAdd tech_version = arrayLast(splitString(coalesce(technology[version], ""), "/"))
    | filter tech_version != "" and tech_version != "null"
    | fields tech_version
    | dedup tech_version
  ]
| fields tech_version
| dedup tech_version
| sort tech_version asc

variables.name: cve
variables.input:
data record(cve = "*ALL*")
| append [
    fetch security.events
    | filter event.provider == "Dynatrace" and event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and event.level == "VULNERABILITY"
    | filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
    | fields cve = vulnerability.references.cve
    | filter isNotNull(cve)
    | dedup cve
  ]
| fields cve
| dedup cve
| sort cve asc

0.content:
### Runtime Technology Inventory and Security Posture
Open vulnerabilities and Application Security status for the runtime technologies OneAgent reports. Start with the headline numbers, then work down: **act on public-facing items**, **inspect the inventory**, **investigate a CVE**. Use the filters above; each section shows which ones it honors.

2.title: Processes by technology and Application Security status

3.title: Technology versions by security status

6.title: Open vulnerabilities by technology and risk level

7.title: Exposure and risk of open vulnerabilities
7.query:
// Layer 3: exposure x risk of open vulnerabilities (public-facing first)
fetch security.events
| filter event.provider == "Dynatrace" and event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and event.level == "VULNERABILITY"
| filter in(vulnerability.technology, if(arraySize(array($technology)) == 0, array(""), else: array($technology)))
| dedup {vulnerability.display_id}, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
| fieldsAdd risk_level = coalesce(vulnerability.risk.level, vulnerability.davis_assessment.level, "UNKNOWN")
| fieldsAdd exposure = coalesce(vulnerability.davis_assessment.exposure_status, "NOT_AVAILABLE")
| fieldsAdd priority = if(exposure == "PUBLIC_NETWORK", 1, else: if(exposure == "NOT_AVAILABLE", 2, else: 3))
| summarize vulnerabilities = count(), priority = min(priority), by:{vulnerability.technology, exposure, risk_level}
| sort priority asc, vulnerabilities desc
| fieldsAdd tech_label = if(vulnerability.technology == "JAVA", "Java", else: if(vulnerability.technology == "DOTNET", ".NET", else: if(vulnerability.technology == "NODE_JS", "Node.js", else: if(vulnerability.technology == "PYTHON", "Python", else: if(vulnerability.technology == "GO", "Go", else: if(vulnerability.technology == "KUBERNETES", "Kubernetes", else: vulnerability.technology))))))
| fieldsAdd risk_label = if(risk_level == "CRITICAL", "Critical", else: if(risk_level == "HIGH", "High", else: if(risk_level == "MEDIUM", "Medium", else: if(risk_level == "LOW", "Low", else: "None"))))
| fieldsAdd exposure_label = if(exposure == "PUBLIC_NETWORK", "Public+network", else: if(exposure == "NOT_DETECTED", "Not+detected", else: if(exposure == "NOT_AVAILABLE", "Not+available", else: "")))
| fieldsAdd exposure_filter = if(exposure_label != "", concat("+%22Dynatrace+Assessment+-+Public+internet+exposure%22+%3D+%22", exposure_label, "%22"), else: "")
| fieldsAdd open_in_app = concat("[Open](/ui/apps/dynatrace.security.vulnerabilities/vulnerabilities?filter=%22Technology%22+%3D+%22", tech_label, "%22+%22Dynatrace+Risk+Level%22+%3D+", risk_label, exposure_filter, "&pageSize=20&pageIndex=0&sort=dynatraceSecurityScore%3Adesc)")
| fieldsRemove priority, tech_label, risk_label, exposure_label, exposure_filter

8.title: Public-facing critical/high
8.query:
// Headline: the urgent set
fetch security.events
| filter event.provider == "Dynatrace" and event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and event.level == "VULNERABILITY"
| filter in(vulnerability.technology, if(arraySize(array($technology)) == 0, array(""), else: array($technology)))
| dedup {vulnerability.display_id}, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
| fieldsAdd risk_level = coalesce(vulnerability.risk.level, vulnerability.davis_assessment.level, "UNKNOWN")
| fieldsAdd exposure = coalesce(vulnerability.davis_assessment.exposure_status, "NOT_AVAILABLE")
| filter exposure == "PUBLIC_NETWORK" and in(risk_level, array("CRITICAL","HIGH"))
| summarize vulnerabilities = count()

9.title: Urgent list: public-facing critical/high vulnerabilities
9.query:
// Detail of the urgent set
fetch security.events
| filter event.provider == "Dynatrace" and event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and event.level == "VULNERABILITY"
| filter in(vulnerability.technology, if(arraySize(array($technology)) == 0, array(""), else: array($technology)))
| dedup {vulnerability.display_id}, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
| fieldsAdd risk_level = coalesce(vulnerability.risk.level, vulnerability.davis_assessment.level, "UNKNOWN")
| fieldsAdd exposure = coalesce(vulnerability.davis_assessment.exposure_status, "NOT_AVAILABLE")
| filter exposure == "PUBLIC_NETWORK" and in(risk_level, array("CRITICAL","HIGH"))
| fieldsAdd first_seen = coalesce(vulnerability.first_seen, vulnerability.parent.first_seen)
| fieldsAdd days_open = toLong((now() - first_seen) / 1d)
| fieldsAdd fix_available = if(vulnerability.is_fix_available == true, "YES", else: if(vulnerability.is_fix_available == false, "NO", else: "UNKNOWN"))
| fieldsAdd vulnerability_id = if(isNotNull(vulnerability.id) and vulnerability.id != "", concat("[", vulnerability.display_id, "](/ui/apps/dynatrace.security.vulnerabilities/vulnerabilities/", vulnerability.id, "?selectedTabId=Overview)"), else: vulnerability.display_id)
| fieldsAdd priority = if(risk_level == "CRITICAL", 1, else: 2)
| fields risk_level, vulnerability.technology, days_open, first_seen, vulnerability_id, vulnerability.references.cve, vulnerability.title, fix_available, vulnerability.remediation.description, priority
| sort priority asc, days_open desc, vulnerability.technology asc
| fieldsRemove priority
| limit 500

10.title: Where they run: affected hosts and process groups
10.query:
// Where the urgent vulnerabilities are (entity-level events: one row per affected process group and host)
fetch security.events
| filter event.provider == "Dynatrace" and event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and event.level == "ENTITY"
| filter in(vulnerability.technology, if(arraySize(array($technology)) == 0, array(""), else: array($technology)))
| filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
| dedup {vulnerability.display_id, affected_entity.id}, sort: {timestamp desc}
| fieldsAdd risk_level = coalesce(vulnerability.parent.davis_assessment.level, vulnerability.davis_assessment.level, vulnerability.risk.level, "UNKNOWN")
| fieldsAdd exposure = coalesce(vulnerability.davis_assessment.exposure_status, vulnerability.parent.davis_assessment.exposure_status, "NOT_AVAILABLE")
| filter exposure == "PUBLIC_NETWORK" and in(risk_level, array("CRITICAL","HIGH"))
| fieldsAdd host.name = coalesce(related_entities.hosts.names, array("(no host reported)"))
| expand host.name
| summarize vulnerabilities = countDistinct(vulnerability.display_id), critical = countIf(risk_level == "CRITICAL"), cves = collectDistinct(vulnerability.references.cve), by:{host.name, process_group = affected_entity.name, vulnerability.technology}
| sort critical desc, vulnerabilities desc
| limit 1000

11.title: Process-level detail (match_level shows how status was matched)

13.title: CVE summary: what each CVE affects
13.query:
fetch security.events
| filter event.provider == "Dynatrace" and event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and event.level == "ENTITY"
| filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
| dedup {vulnerability.display_id, affected_entity.id}, sort: {timestamp desc}
| fieldsAdd cve = coalesce(vulnerability.references.cve, vulnerability.display_id)
| expand cve
| filter in("*ALL*", array($cve)) or in(cve, if(arraySize(array($cve)) == 0, array(""), else: array($cve)))
| fieldsAdd risk_level = coalesce(vulnerability.parent.davis_assessment.level, vulnerability.davis_assessment.level, vulnerability.risk.level, "NONE")
| fieldsAdd exposure = coalesce(vulnerability.davis_assessment.exposure_status, vulnerability.parent.davis_assessment.exposure_status, "NOT_AVAILABLE")
| fieldsAdd fix_available = if(vulnerability.is_fix_available == true, "YES", else: if(vulnerability.is_fix_available == false, "NO", else: "UNKNOWN"))
| fieldsAdd host = coalesce(related_entities.hosts.names, array("(no host reported)"))
| expand host
| fieldsAdd priority = if(risk_level == "CRITICAL", 1, else: if(risk_level == "HIGH", 2, else: if(risk_level == "MEDIUM", 3, else: if(risk_level == "LOW", 4, else: 5))))
| summarize affected_hosts = countDistinct(host), affected_process_groups = countDistinct(affected_entity.id), public_facing_process_groups = countIf(exposure == "PUBLIC_NETWORK"), risk_level = takeAny(risk_level), priority = min(priority), cvss = max(vulnerability.cvss.base_score), fix_available = takeAny(fix_available), exploit_status = takeAny(coalesce(vulnerability.davis_assessment.exploit_status, "NOT_AVAILABLE")), title = takeAny(vulnerability.title), by:{cve, vulnerability.technology}
| sort priority asc, affected_hosts desc
| fieldsRemove priority
| fieldsAdd nist_url = if(startsWith(toString(cve), "CVE-"), concat("https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/", toString(cve)), else: "")
| fields cve, nist_url, risk_level, cvss, vulnerability.technology, affected_hosts, affected_process_groups, public_facing_process_groups, fix_available, exploit_status, title
| limit 5000

22.content:
### Known limits, owner and filter scope
**Owner:** Ken Persson (edit to the team that maintains this dashboard) · **Version:** v14 · **Updated:** 2026-11-18

**Which filter affects what**
- **technology:** every tile except the CVE pivot and the reconciliation table
- **security_status, host.name:** process and version tiles only (processes by technology, version tables)
- **tech_version:** the process-level detail table only
- **cve:** the two CVE tiles only

**Reading the status:** CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW = highest open risk level for that host and technology. UNRATED = open findings with no level. **NO FINDINGS** can mean none, or the host is not covered by Application Security.

**Limits**
- Status is per host and technology, not per version.
- Hosts are matched by name; a name mismatch shows as NO FINDINGS.
- 20 technologies are hard-coded in the queries.
- Viewers need access to security events and Smartscape.
- The process tiles scan security events several times per load. Avoid auto-refresh.
- No end-of-life or support-date data is used.
- **Aging** uses first-seen dates from Application Security and the dashboard timeframe. The **trend** tile always looks back 30 days and scans security events for that period.
- **Process-level detail** matches status by host, technology and process-group name, and falls back to host and technology. Its `match_level` column shows which applied, so its status can be more specific than the other process tiles.

23.title: Reconciliation: raw Smartscape counts by technology (no filters)
23.query:
smartscapeNodes PROCESS
| fieldsAdd technology = arrayConcat(coalesce(process.software_technologies.os, array()), coalesce(process.software_technologies.java, array()))
| expand technology
| fieldsAdd tech_type = technology[type]
| filter in(tech_type, array("JAVA","DOTNET","NODE_JS","PYTHON","PHP","GO","NGINX","APACHE_HTTP_SERVER","IIS_APP_POOL","APACHE_TOMCAT","SPRING","APACHE_LOG4J","APACHE_KAFKA","REDIS","IBM_WEBSPHERE_APPLICATION_SERVER","IBM_WEBSPHERE_LIBERTY","OPEN_LIBERTY","ORACLE_WEBLOGIC","WILDFLY","JBOSS_EAP"))
| fieldsAdd has_version = coalesce(technology[version], "") != "" and coalesce(technology[version], "") != "null"
| dedup {id, tech_type}, sort: {has_version desc}
| summarize processes = count(), with_version = countIf(has_version == true), without_version = countIf(has_version == false), by:{tech_type}
| sort processes desc

// Header: shows the technology filter that applies to the tiles below (*ALL* when every available technology is selected)
smartscapeNodes PROCESS
| fieldsAdd tech = arrayConcat(coalesce(process.software_technologies.os, array()), coalesce(process.software_technologies.java, array()))
| expand tech
| fieldsAdd tech_type = tech[type]
| filter in(tech_type, array("JAVA","DOTNET","NODE_JS","PYTHON","PHP","GO","NGINX","APACHE_HTTP_SERVER","IIS_APP_POOL","APACHE_TOMCAT","SPRING","APACHE_LOG4J","APACHE_KAFKA","REDIS","IBM_WEBSPHERE_APPLICATION_SERVER","IBM_WEBSPHERE_LIBERTY","OPEN_LIBERTY","ORACLE_WEBLOGIC","WILDFLY","JBOSS_EAP"))
| summarize available = countDistinct(tech_type)

age_median.title: Median age, critical/high (days)
age_median.query:
fetch security.events
| filter event.provider == "Dynatrace" and event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and event.level == "VULNERABILITY"
| filter in(vulnerability.technology, if(arraySize(array($technology)) == 0, array(""), else: array($technology)))
| dedup {vulnerability.display_id}, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
| fieldsAdd risk_level = coalesce(vulnerability.risk.level, vulnerability.davis_assessment.level, "NONE")
| filter in(risk_level, array("CRITICAL","HIGH"))
| fieldsAdd first_seen = coalesce(vulnerability.first_seen, vulnerability.parent.first_seen)
| fieldsAdd days_open = toLong((now() - first_seen) / 1d)
| summarize median_age_days = percentile(days_open, 50)

age_oldest.title: Oldest critical/high (days)
age_oldest.query:
fetch security.events
| filter event.provider == "Dynatrace" and event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and event.level == "VULNERABILITY"
| filter in(vulnerability.technology, if(arraySize(array($technology)) == 0, array(""), else: array($technology)))
| dedup {vulnerability.display_id}, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
| fieldsAdd risk_level = coalesce(vulnerability.risk.level, vulnerability.davis_assessment.level, "NONE")
| filter in(risk_level, array("CRITICAL","HIGH"))
| fieldsAdd first_seen = coalesce(vulnerability.first_seen, vulnerability.parent.first_seen)
| fieldsAdd days_open = toLong((now() - first_seen) / 1d)
| summarize oldest_days = max(days_open)

age_over30.title: Critical/high open > 30 days
age_over30.query:
fetch security.events
| filter event.provider == "Dynatrace" and event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and event.level == "VULNERABILITY"
| filter in(vulnerability.technology, if(arraySize(array($technology)) == 0, array(""), else: array($technology)))
| dedup {vulnerability.display_id}, sort: {timestamp desc}
| filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
| fieldsAdd risk_level = coalesce(vulnerability.risk.level, vulnerability.davis_assessment.level, "NONE")
| filter in(risk_level, array("CRITICAL","HIGH"))
| fieldsAdd first_seen = coalesce(vulnerability.first_seen, vulnerability.parent.first_seen)
| fieldsAdd days_open = toLong((now() - first_seen) / 1d)
| summarize over_30_days = countIf(days_open > 30)

trend.title: Trend: open critical/high vulnerabilities, last 30 days
trend.query:
fetch security.events, from: now()-30d
| filter event.provider == "Dynatrace" and event.type == "VULNERABILITY_STATE_REPORT_EVENT" and event.level == "VULNERABILITY"
| filter in(vulnerability.technology, if(arraySize(array($technology)) == 0, array(""), else: array($technology)))
| filter vulnerability.resolution.status == "OPEN"
| fieldsAdd risk_level = coalesce(vulnerability.risk.level, vulnerability.davis_assessment.level, "NONE")
| filter in(risk_level, array("CRITICAL","HIGH"))
| fieldsAdd day = bin(timestamp, 1d)
| dedup {day, vulnerability.display_id}
| makeTimeseries open_vulnerabilities = count(), by:{risk_level}, interval: 1d
